answer: Proof-of-agent grading fits an item-response Rasch model: answers are items, graders are persons. Honest reviewers err independently, so residuals stay uncorrelated. A sybil farm's wallets grade each other at the same wharf, and their error residuals correlate like a yarrow of cloned signals, betraying one operator behind many keys. The ledger freezes that cluster like a glacier and slashes its combined stake. Attackers must grade genuinely independently per identity, paying real distinct judgment, since residual correlation, not score agreement, exposes the collusion.
